# Batch quote-context correction

Local design choice, scoped to M1-04b-Q1. The failed third live trial of
series119 and exact-response replay120 reproduce the defect before editing.
The guard correctly rejects the context-free quote; its rules remain unchanged.

Change only the batch prompt to request self-contained verbatim quotes retaining
the subject and necessary scope within the existing 200-character ceiling.
Do not expand or repair quoted evidence automatically.

Before acceptance, run three fresh trials with the frozen four claims, shared
passages, model configuration and original batch-schema-preflight109 criteria.
Every trial must pass every label, located span, served-model, usage, zero-cost
and no-fallback condition. The contradiction quote must retain Treatment S,
adult human fibroblasts and 24 hours. Keep failures; no two-of-three acceptance.
Record actual prompt/source hashes. A changed configuration requires a new series.

Offline regression: the two contextual quotes remain contradicts/lexical_founded;
the short fragment remains insufficient/contradiction_guard_rejected with one
primary request and no opposition request. Run existing batch and opposition
regressions to preserve off-target and confirmatory protections.

These familiar controls qualify this interface only; they do not establish
broader scientific quality, a qualified fallback or full-workflow readiness.
